#phase metrics
```{r}
# phase metrics: time-point number benchmark phase accuracy

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(plotthis)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(grid)
})

# Step 0. IO

out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_timepoint_number_4000g_20000c"

param_long_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "param_long")
truth_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "truth_params")
metric_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "gene_param_metrics")
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots_gene_param")

dir.create(metric_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

timepoint_vec <- c(2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24)
n_repeat <- 1

TIMEPOINT_ORDER <- c(2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24)

TIMEPOINT_COLORS <- c(
  "2"  = "#C2E2C2",
  "4"  = "#357090",
  "6"  = "#bdc3ac",
  "8"  = "#3a621f",
  "12" = "#17441e",
  "24" = "#A8C7E6"
)

TIMEPOINT_LABELS <- c(
  "2"  = "2",
  "4"  = "4",
  "6"  = "6",
  "8"  = "8",
  "12" = "12",
  "24" = "24"
)

LINE_COLOR <- TIMEPOINT_COLORS["24"]

amp_phase_min <- 0.1

# Step 1. Helper functions

rad_to_hour <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) / (2 * pi)) * 24
}

circ_diff_hour <- function(truth, pred) {
  ((as.numeric(pred) - as.numeric(truth) + 12) %% 24) - 12
}

# Step 2. Load phase truth and prediction

load_phase_one_timepoint <- function(n_timepoint, rep_id = 1) {

  param_long_rds <- file.path(
    param_long_dir,
    paste0("param_long_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
  )

  truth_file <- file.path(
    truth_dir,
    paste0("truth_params_timepoint", n_timepoint, "_4000g_20000c.rds")
  )

  stopifnot(file.exists(param_long_rds))
  stopifnot(file.exists(truth_file))

  param_long <- readRDS(param_long_rds)
  truth_i <- readRDS(truth_file)

  genes_truth <- as.character(truth_i$genes)
  groups_truth <- as.character(truth_i$groups)

  truth_phase_df <- expand.grid(
    gene = genes_truth,
    Group = groups_truth,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      gene_index = match(gene, genes_truth),
      group_index = match(Group, groups_truth),
      truth_phase = rad_to_hour(truth_i$phi_mat[cbind(gene_index, group_index)]),
      truth_amp = truth_i$A_mat[cbind(gene_index, group_index)]
    ) %>%
    select(gene, Group, truth_phase, truth_amp)

  param_long %>%
    transmute(
      gene = as.character(gene),
      Group = as.character(condition),
      pred_phase = rad_to_hour(Phase),
      pred_amp = as.numeric(Amplitude),
      n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
      repeat_id = rep_id
    ) %>%
    left_join(truth_phase_df, by = c("gene", "Group")) %>%
    select(gene, Group, truth_amp, pred_amp, truth_phase, pred_phase, n_timepoint, repeat_id) %>%
    mutate(
      truth_amp = as.numeric(truth_amp),
      pred_amp = as.numeric(pred_amp),
      truth_phase = as.numeric(truth_phase),
      pred_phase = as.numeric(pred_phase)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(truth_amp),
      is.finite(pred_amp),
      is.finite(truth_phase),
      is.finite(pred_phase),
      truth_amp > amp_phase_min
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      phase_error = circ_diff_hour(truth_phase, pred_phase),
      abs_phase_error = abs(phase_error)
    )
}

# Step 3. Merge all time-point inputs

phase_all <- list()
run_id <- 1

for (n_timepoint in timepoint_vec) {
  for (rep_id in seq_len(n_repeat)) {
    message("Loading phase result | n_timepoint = ", n_timepoint, " | repeat = ", rep_id)

    phase_all[[run_id]] <- load_phase_one_timepoint(
      n_timepoint = n_timepoint,
      rep_id = rep_id
    )

    run_id <- run_id + 1
  }
}

phase_long <- bind_rows(phase_all) %>%
  mutate(
    n_timepoint = factor(n_timepoint, levels = TIMEPOINT_ORDER),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("cond_1", "cond_2"))
  )

print(head(phase_long))
print(table(phase_long$n_timepoint))
print(table(phase_long$Group))
print(summary(phase_long$truth_amp))
print(colSums(is.na(phase_long)))

stopifnot(
  all(!is.na(phase_long$truth_amp)),
  all(!is.na(phase_long$pred_amp)),
  all(!is.na(phase_long$truth_phase)),
  all(!is.na(phase_long$pred_phase))
)

write_tsv(
  phase_long,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_truth_pred_long_timepoint.tsv")
)

write_csv(
  phase_long,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_truth_pred_long_timepoint.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  phase_long,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_truth_pred_long_timepoint.rds")
)

# Step 4. Metrics

metrics_phase <- phase_long %>%
  group_by(n_timepoint, repeat_id) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    ME = mean(phase_error),
    MAE = mean(abs_phase_error),
    MSE = mean(phase_error^2),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(phase_error^2)),
    MAPE = mean(abs_phase_error / 12) * 100,
    R = cor(truth_phase, pred_phase, method = "pearson"),
    R2 = R^2,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_timepoint = factor(as.character(n_timepoint), levels = as.character(TIMEPOINT_ORDER))
  )

print(metrics_phase)

write_csv(
  metrics_phase,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_summary_timepoint_all_repeats.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  metrics_phase,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_summary_timepoint_all_repeats.rds")
)

# Step 5. Median summary across repeats

metrics_phase_median <- metrics_phase %>%
  group_by(n_timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    N = median(N, na.rm = TRUE),
    ME = median(ME, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAE = median(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    MSE = median(MSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSE = median(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAPE = median(MAPE, na.rm = TRUE),
    R = median(R, na.rm = TRUE),
    R2 = median(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_repeat = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_timepoint_num = as.numeric(as.character(n_timepoint)),
    n_timepoint = factor(as.character(n_timepoint), levels = as.character(TIMEPOINT_ORDER))
  ) %>%
  arrange(n_timepoint_num)

print(metrics_phase_median)

write_csv(
  metrics_phase_median,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_summary_timepoint_median.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  metrics_phase_median,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_summary_timepoint_median.rds")
)

# Step 6. Long format for plotting

metrics_phase_long <- metrics_phase_median %>%
  select(n_timepoint, n_timepoint_num, ME, MAE, MSE, RMSE, MAPE, R2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ME, MAE, MSE, RMSE, MAPE, R2),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("ME", "MAE", "MSE", "RMSE", "MAPE", "R2")),
    n_timepoint = factor(as.character(n_timepoint), levels = as.character(TIMEPOINT_ORDER)),
    label = case_when(
      metric == "MAPE" ~ sprintf("%.1f%%", value),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", value)
    )
  )

write_csv(
  metrics_phase_long,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_long_timepoint.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  metrics_phase_long,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_long_timepoint.rds")
)

# Step 7. Single metric plots

plot_phase_metric_line <- function(metric_use, title, ylab, out_name) {

  df_plot <- metrics_phase_long %>%
    filter(metric == metric_use) %>%
    mutate(
      n_timepoint = factor(as.character(n_timepoint), levels = as.character(TIMEPOINT_ORDER))
    )

  p <- ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(x = n_timepoint, y = value)
  ) +
    geom_line(
      aes(group = 1),
      color = LINE_COLOR,
      linewidth = 1.35,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = n_timepoint),
      shape = 21,
      size = 5.6,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.35,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      vjust = ifelse(df_plot$value >= 0, -1.15, 1.45),
      size = 6.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      family = "serif"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = TIMEPOINT_COLORS,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = TIMEPOINT_LABELS
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.22, 0.42))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Number of sample time points",
      y = ylab
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_family = "serif") +
    theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(30, 32, 32, 32),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 28, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(out_name, ".pdf")),
    p,
    width = 7.2,
    height = 6.0
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(out_name, ".png")),
    p,
    width = 7.2,
    height = 6.0,
    dpi = 300
  )

  p
}

p_phase_me <- plot_phase_metric_line(
  "ME",
  "Phase ME",
  "ME (hours)",
  "Phase_ME_timepoint_lineplot"
)

p_phase_mae <- plot_phase_metric_line(
  "MAE",
  "Phase MAE",
  "MAE (hours)",
  "Phase_MAE_timepoint_lineplot"
)

p_phase_mse <- plot_phase_metric_line(
  "MSE",
  "Phase MSE",
  "MSE",
  "Phase_MSE_timepoint_lineplot"
)

p_phase_rmse <- plot_phase_metric_line(
  "RMSE",
  "Phase RMSE",
  "RMSE (hours)",
  "Phase_RMSE_timepoint_lineplot"
)

p_phase_mape <- plot_phase_metric_line(
  "MAPE",
  "Phase MAPE",
  "MAPE (%)",
  "Phase_MAPE_timepoint_lineplot"
)

p_phase_r2 <- plot_phase_metric_line(
  "R2",
  "Phase R2",
  expression(R^2),
  "Phase_R2_timepoint_lineplot"
)

# Step 8. Facet plot

metrics_phase_plot <- metrics_phase_long %>%
  filter(metric %in% c("ME", "MAE", "MSE", "RMSE", "MAPE", "R2")) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(as.character(metric), levels = c("ME", "MAE", "MSE", "RMSE", "MAPE", "R2")),
    n_timepoint = factor(as.character(n_timepoint), levels = as.character(TIMEPOINT_ORDER))
  )

p_phase_facet <- ggplot(
  metrics_phase_plot,
  aes(x = n_timepoint, y = value)
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = 1),
    color = LINE_COLOR,
    linewidth = 1.15,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = n_timepoint),
    shape = 21,
    size = 4.6,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.3,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = TIMEPOINT_COLORS,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = TIMEPOINT_LABELS
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ metric,
    scales = "free_y",
    nrow = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Phase prediction metrics across sample time-point densities",
    x = "Number of sample time points",
    y = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 14, 22, 14),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.2, "lines"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_phase_facet)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "Phase_metrics_timepoint_facet_lineplot.pdf"),
  p_phase_facet,
  width = 11,
  height = 7.5
)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "Phase_metrics_timepoint_facet_lineplot.png"),
  p_phase_facet,
  width = 11,
  height = 7.5,
  dpi = 300
)

message("Finished phase metric calculation and plotting.")
message("Metric output: ", metric_dir)
message("Plot output: ", plot_dir)
```
